messages:
maya: CI nightly e2e perf gate just turned red — longseq p95 jumped ~40% compared to yesterday. anyone on a quick triage?
ci-bot: Job failed: nightly-e2e/longseq · run/4821 · status=FAILED · see https://ci.redwood.internal/4821 (auto-post) :warning:
sam: I'll take a look. can someone paste the failing job link + suspect commit range?
ryan: link: https://ci.redwood.internal/4821 — failing tests show p95 latency around 860ms vs baseline 600ms. stacktrace looks like KV cache miss storms in logs. snippet:```[2026-03-17T02:11:05Z] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.78, batch_delay=12ms, tokens/sec=2200```
lina: fwiw we rolled a small scheduling tweak in runtime yesterday ~11:30pm (commit 8f3a2d9). could be related.
sam: can you post the exact commit range for the nightly run? i'll queue a focused bisect/rerun.
ryan: nightly pinned 8f3a2d9..d41b7ee (includes the scheduler patch + a metrics change).
sam: ok. planning: 1) quick rerun the failing job with longer warmup, 2) bisect across that range if rerun reproduces. who can approve an extra warmup allocation? @ops
ops: i can spin a warmup node for 1h. tell me the job id and tag.
sam: thanks — rerun command i'm using:```./ci/rerun_job.sh --id 4821 --env WARMUP_SECONDS=600 --note "triage-warmup"```
ryan: re: reproduce: try forcing KV cache off to confirm hypothesis:```REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=0 ./ci/rerun_job.sh --id 4821 --env WARMUP_SECONDS=600```
lina: if that reduces p95 then we know cache eviction behavior changed. also try running with MODEL_VARIANT=quantized-8 to see perf delta.
maya: also flagging that the canary auto-fallback to smaller model didn't trigger; might be routing policy glitch. worth checking routing logs if rerun is flaky.
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: nightly-e2e/longseq · new-run/4821-1 · user=sam · status=QUEUED
sam: cool. i'll grab the rerun results when done and start fast bisect if it reproduces.
ryan: one more: attaching the perf heatmap link: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/4821/heatmap — shows bursty tail between 2-4s at backend spike.
sam: if rerun reproduces i'll kick off bisect with binary split and post interim results here. if not, i'll compare env differences and re-evaluate.
maya: thanks team. small request: if you bisect, keep each bisect job to 30m so we don't blow credits. :+1:
ci-bot: Run started: new-run/4821-1 · status=RUNNING
[later]
ci-bot: Run complete: new-run/4821-1 · status=FAILED · p95=872ms · note=triage-warmup
sam: rerun still reproduced. starting bisect now across 8f3a2d9..d41b7ee. will post gen progress.
ryan: thanks — ping me if you need logs parsed. i can grep eviction events.
lina: i'll open a tiny PR to revert the scheduler tweak if bisect points to it, so we can test rollback quickly.
ci-bot: Bisect job queued: bisect/8f3a2d9..d41b7ee · queue/3
sam: update: first bisect run points at commit 8f3a2d9 as first bad — looks like scheduler change is suspicious. starting a confirm run on that single commit.
maya: nice. once confirmed let's decide rollback vs fix. both OK but prefer a minimal fix if possible.
ci-bot: Confirm run started: confirm/8f3a2d9 · status=RUNNING
[end]
